newsitem.title: USA: Boston passenger bus falls into icy river.
newsitem.headline: Boston passenger bus falls into icy river.

text.p: A passenger bus plunged into the icy Charles River late on Monday, police said.
The Massachusetts Bay Tranportation Authority Bus apparently crashed into the river that runs between Boston and Cambridge near one of the major crossings shortly after 10 p.m. EST (0300 GMT).
"We have a whole flood of emergency vehicles at the scene. There are divers in the water. We are searching for any passengers and the driver," said MBTA police officer Michael Feeley.
Hospitals in the area on alert, he said. It was unclear how many people may have been on the vehicle.
